'''Laliah''' is an NPC in {{Location|Startorch Academy (Region)|nocat=1}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Laliah:''' Hey, want a hug?
:{{DIcon}} A hug?
:'''Laliah:''' Yeah, a hug.
:'''Laliah:''' Haha, don't take it the wrong way. For us Roya, a hug is a kind of greeting. It means warmth, care...
:'''Laliah:''' Maybe it's because the frostlands are so bitterly cold that everyone's come to love hudddling together for warmth.
:'''Laliah:''' So if you're ever lonely, tired, or down... come find me. I've got a hug for you.
{{Dialogue End}}
